falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 79% similarity to bottom_2024_aug pattern would be broken, as that bottom held above the prior swing low; a break below 4,800 invalidates the structural bottom formation and suggests continuation lower, not a bottom

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 indicates controlled fear/positioning reset; sustained VIX above 35 signals panic selling and systemic stress, not the capitulation-then-stability dynamic implied by the pattern match

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield falls below 3.80% while S&P 500 is also declining day-over-day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a true flight-to-safety recession scare, not the growth-scare-then-recovery pattern of August 2024; the correlated bond-equity rally would confirm macro deterioration incompatible with a bottom call
